preflight_findings_surfaced: WB2 capacitance arithmetic confused specific (uF/cm^2) vs total (pF) capacitance; corrected values: AVAL 9.66 pF (10x), AVAR 8.43 pF (12x), AIY 1.05 pF (95x), RIM 1.55 pF (65x). Mismatch direction preserved; magnitude overstated for AVAL/AVAR. F20 catalog entry should record corrected values.
Wicks 1996 covers neither AIY nor RIM; parameters are Ascaris-extrapolated. AVA's Wicks-style params reasonable per Mellem 2008 alignment; AIY/RIM are pure extrapolation.
